page.overview:
Who is Firion?

Firion is a minor character in World of Final Fantasy Maxima. He is a Grymoirian incarnation of Firion originating from Final Fantasy II, and is the sole character representative for that game. Firion does not make an appearance in the game's main storyline, but information mentioning him is present in excerpts of Old Journalist Notes and the Who's Who of his presence in Grymoire long before Lann and Reynn's awakening.

Collecting all five excerpts of Old Journalist Notes scattered through Grymoire unlocks , which can be bought at The Girl's Tearoom for two s. Equipping this Mirajewel on Lann makes him take on the appearance of Firion, and inherits the abilities and Conserve Item.

An arrangement of "The Rebel Army" plays when Lann is equipped with Firion's Champion Jewel. The player may also select this theme as the background music for battles from the Config section of the main menu, labeled as "Champion Theme: Firion".
